newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bond spreads firm as Treasuries dive.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bond spreads firm as Treasuries dive.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond spreads capitalized on a precipitous drop in the Treasury market on Wednesday and tightened about two basis points across most sectors, dealers said.

Some prospective issuers stepped-back from the market after massive foreign selling of Treasuries sent yields there sharply higher. Trust preferred issuers were exceptions, however, and Countrywide Capital I, Merrill Lynch Capital Trust and MBNA Capital Trust combined to tap the market with $825 million in the securities.
